issue_context.title: kvserver: factor out SideloadStorage to log package
issue_context.body:
[SideloadStorage](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/47c7b3a1bc047fc3e481cf12166885b39519c022/pkg/kv/kvserver/replica_sideload.go#L30) interface and implementation is one of the pieces of a separated log storage. Within the bigger effort of factoring out the log storage, moving the `SideloadStorage` to a separate package is among reasonable first steps.

Part of #91979
Epic: CRDB-220

Jira issue: CRDB-21475

review_comments: All these will be unexported again when more things move to `logstore`.
